steps.title: Your first run
steps.body: You are Teresā Albukerkē, and you lost the election. You have until Tuesday at 2 p.m., 72 hours from now, to reach a jet and fly out. This demo guides you across the border, and you finish the run at the airfield on your own.
steps.goal: Know the goal and the deadline

steps.title: Reading the scene
steps.body: The marker over your head is you, and the police box shows where the police are searching. While they search where you are, your police attention climbs, and at 10 they stop you. Each stop within 12 hours of the last is worse, and the third step is house arrest.
steps.goal: Read police attention and where the police are searching

steps.title: A round
steps.body: Each turn, answer anyone who calls, make up to one call, then make one move. When the move is done, you see what happened during the hours it took, including what the police did.
steps.goal: Know what a turn is

steps.title: Your brother is on the phone
steps.body: Duartē has found a jet, but the crew will not book the flight until he gives them a city. Tap **Confirm Lagoa Funda**, the city in Altamira the demo picked for you.
steps.goal: Answer a message

steps.title: Call about the jet
steps.body: Tap **Your sibling about the jet**, then **Call**. The call takes an hour, and his answer comes six hours after that.
steps.goal: Start an arrangement by phone

steps.title: Waiting on Duartē
steps.body: The route shows when Duartē owes you an answer, but he still has to come through. If he fails, you call again.
steps.goal: Tell a promise from a delivered arrangement

steps.title: Get out of the house
steps.body: Pick **Send out a decoy convoy**, then tap **Try it**. You can do this because Nando gave you the cars.
steps.goal: Send out the decoy convoy

steps.title: Cards help you
steps.body: Cards lower the number you need, and using one does not use it up. You lose a card when its owner turns on you or you give it up. You are in Pedra Branca now, and the police are still searching the residence.
steps.goal: See how cards help your moves

steps.title: The police move too
steps.body: Every three hours, the police do something. This time they sent the travel ban to every post. If they stop you now, they take you straight to the station. Each border crossing is also harder, unless you hold a card that delays the report.
steps.goal: See the inquiry act on a schedule

steps.title: Ask for the visa
steps.body: Tap **Bīr Amādū Salek about your visa**, then **Call**. He can get Altamira to let you in. Later he asks for the family accounts. Agreeing makes the visa more likely, and if you refuse he still asks at the usual odds.
steps.goal: Ask a sponsor for your visa

steps.title: Pay someone who takes money
steps.body: Nando's cousin drives for cash. Pick **Hire a plain car and driver**, then tap **Try it**.
steps.goal: Use an ally who takes money

steps.title: Things moved while you drove
steps.body: Duartē booked the crew, and the ministry told the papers you had left the country. The police are searching the residence in Portô Venla, which is not where you are.
steps.goal: See arrangements progress while you travel

steps.title: Nonā Rosa needs something first
steps.body: Her cooperative's truck was impounded this morning. Pick **Help Nonā Rosa free the truck**, then tap **Try it**. It takes three hours. She gives you the truck either way, and if it works, her truck also carries you on to Salta.
steps.goal: Earn help by helping

steps.title: Help earns trust
steps.body: You are in Salta now. Nonā Rosa's truck helps your moves here without you doing anything. Helping her also made her trust you more, and people who trust you are less likely to talk when the police question them.
steps.goal: Know that trust lowers the risk of betrayal

steps.title: Who meets you on the other side
steps.body: Tap **Your sibling about your welcome in Costamar**, then **Call**. He can reach Rosario Vélez in Costamar. Each call that comes through moves your welcome one step, and at the third step her officials wait for you at one border post.
steps.goal: Arrange reception across the line

steps.title: A crate from Holt
steps.body: Pick **Pay Holt for a crate**, then tap **Try it**. Your truck card makes this easier. Never pay the yardmaster. He takes the money and tells the yard who you are, and your police attention rises by two.
steps.goal: Get a card for one place

steps.title: Onto the train
steps.body: Holt's crate works only in the Salta yard, and only at night. Pick **Board the midnight freight**, then tap **Try it**. The crate is gone once the train leaves Salta.
steps.goal: Spend a card where it counts

steps.title: The line
steps.body: Three posts cross into Costamar, and Valdória has paid one of them. You do not know which. If Duartē's calls get Vélez's officials to the line, they meet you at one of the other two, and they walk you straight through.
steps.goal: Know what the three posts mean

steps.title: The rail post
steps.body: Pick **Cross at the Paso Huhūi post**, then tap **Try it**. Your second passport lets you try it, and the party machine lowers the number you need. The travel ban and your well-known face each raise it.
steps.goal: See how the ban makes crossing harder

steps.title: Portalba
steps.body: You made it across. Costamar lets you fly out of Portalba and nothing more, and your party's cards do not count in this country. You can board once the jet is ready and the visa is issued. Tap **Finish** to play the rest on your own.
steps.goal: Play the airfield alone

steps.title: Your first run as Sofīā
steps.goal: Know the goal and what you cannot see
steps.body: You are Sofīā Leōnī, aide to the incoming government. Teresā Albukerkē has until Tuesday at 2 p.m. to fly out, and your job is to stop her. You never see where she is, only reports, and reports come late.

steps.title: Reading the scene
steps.goal: Tell your search from her position
steps.body: The scene shows where your people are looking, and the box marked Last report says how old your newest report is. She could be at any stop on the route.

steps.title: A round
steps.goal: Know what a turn is
steps.body: Each turn, answer the minister, send up to one request, then give one order. When the order is done, you see what came back during the hours it took.

steps.title: The minister wants a town
steps.goal: Answer a message without guessing
steps.body: If you name the wrong town, the minister announces it on the news, every desk in the province drives there, and it counts against you at the end. Pick **Ask for six hours**.

steps.title: Ask Costamar now
steps.goal: Start a slow request before you need it
steps.body: Your orders stop at the border, and the embassy in Cerro Alto takes 10 hours to answer, so ask Costamar now. Pick **Ask Costamar to hold her**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Put the ban on paper
steps.goal: Read an order before sending it
steps.body: Pick **Circulate the travel ban**, read how long it takes, then tap **Send the order**.

steps.title: Reading reports
steps.goal: Judge a report by what it proves
steps.body: She moved while your order ran. Tap **Read the new reports**. Each report says what it proves and what it does not. A car leaving a house does not prove she is in the car.

steps.title: Things happen at the ministry
steps.goal: Weigh a choice by what it costs and brings
steps.body: Every five hours something lands on your desk. Each choice lists what it costs and what it can bring, and a false lead leaves you a report from a stop where she is not. On the news card, pick **Check the one that gave plates**.

steps.title: Confirming the ban
steps.goal: Confirm a request reached the people who act on it
steps.body: The ban is in force, so every crossing she tries is harder, but nobody at the post has confirmed it yet. Pick **Confirm the ban at the post**, then **Send**, to have the post confirm it.

steps.title: Act on the lead
steps.goal: Move the search to the newest report
steps.body: The plates were real. Follow the report to point your search at Pedra Branca. Following a report puts nobody on the ground, so then tap **Search Pedra Branca**.

steps.title: How she gets caught
steps.goal: Know how searches turn into holds
steps.body: While the police are on her stop, her police attention climbs, and at 10 they stop her; you never see that number. Each stop within 12 hours of the last is worse, and the third step is house arrest, which is your win. She also takes riskier moves to get away while your people are on her stop.

steps.title: The rest is yours
steps.goal: Play on without the guide
steps.body: From here the die and the news are no longer scripted. The debrief at the end shows where she really was. Tap **Finish**.
